shattered_gauntlet.title: Shattered Gauntlet
shattered_gauntlet.memory_text: Your hand was covered in rain and stone dust. You held her fingers for half a second. Then your glove slipped.

herbalists_satchel.title: Herbalist's Satchel
herbalists_satchel.memory_text: Elysia carried this pouch everywhere to collect mountain herbs. She promised she'd be back before sunset.

voragis_inkwell.title: Voragis's Inkwell
voragis_inkwell.memory_text: The debt collector didn't ask for gold. He asked if you'd give up your soul to drag her out. The Evil Eye laughed as you signed.

hollowed_ledger_page.title: Hollowed Ledger Page
hollowed_ledger_page.memory_text: A list of everyone who made this deal before you. Every single one failed and turned into the skeletons roaming these woods.

candoras_tear.title: Candora's Tear
candoras_tear.memory_text: A warm stone left at a ruined altar. A quiet reminder from the Moon Knight that someone is rooting for you to stay human.

amalgam_core.title: Amalgam Core
amalgam_core.memory_text: This monster was Voragis's prototype—a horrible mix of human souls and shadow power. It's what you will turn into if you lose control.

evil_eye.name: The Evil Eye (Voragis's Devil)
barks: Slash deeper, soldier! Use the shadow! Every second you hesitate, her soul slips lower!
Feel that power? Voragis loves watching you burn through your mortal blood!
Don't stop running! Your pulse is the ink signing this contract!

moon_knight.name: The Moon Knight (Candora's Angel)
barks: Hold onto her name, Kaelen! Every time you summon the flame, her face fades in your mind.
Stay human, runner. Candora's silver light still reaches into these woods.
The debt is a trap. Win the race, but keep your heart intact.
